messages:
elena: quick FYI — during a small docs sweep I hit a 404 in the runtime guide (kv-cache prefetch anchor).
elena: link: https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/kv-cache#prefetch — returns 404 in staging and prod.
sam: thanks for flagging. can you paste the failing curl? I can do a quick PR if it's just a migrated anchor.
elena: sure
elena: ```
curl -I https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/kv-cache#prefetch
HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
``` 
matt: 😬 that's probably the anchor id changed in the last TOC refactor. @sam if you're doing a sed, i'd suggest updating both runtime and the onboarding doc that links to it.
sam: copy. planning a tiny PR. quick sed patch to fix the anchor in runtime:
```
git checkout -b fix/docs-kv-prefetch
# replace old anchor id
rg "#prefetch" -n && sed -i '' 's/#prefetch/#kv-prefetch/g' docs/runtime/kv-cache.md
git add -A && git commit -m \"docs: fix kv-cache prefetch anchor\"
git push origin fix/docs-kv-prefetch
```
elena: thanks. can you also drop a note in the PR description listing places to update? ran a grep and found 3 links.
sam: will do — pinging for reviewers: @matt @kai
kai: I can review this afternoon (ETA ~2pm). assign to me.
docs-bot: link-scan alert: 1 impacted doc detected by nightly run (rule: anchor-mismatch). See https://internal.redwood/alerts/LS-20260321-47
matt: if it's trivial, we can merge after kai's review and auto-backport to staging via our bot.
elena: lovely. adding this to today's handoff checklist so oncall sees it.
elena: checklist note: owner=sam, reviewer=kai, scope=runtime + onboarding, impact=low, merge-window=today
sam: PR up in 10m, will post link here.
sam: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 — tiny, includes sed+one-line changelog
kai: lgtm on the diff, left one minor nit about heading punctuation.
matt: merging after nit fix. thanks all :thumbsup:
elena: closing loop — thanks everyone!
